paite: Huchi in David khopi sung ah David in innte akibawl a; Pathian bawm a ding in mun abawl a, puanin akaihsakta hi.
heading: Pathian Bawm La Dia Kisakkholhna

paite: Huai lai in David in, "Levi mite chih louh kuamah in Pathian bawm apo ding ahi kei: TOUPA'N lah amau Pathian bawm po ding leh tangtawn a amah nna sepsak ding in amaute ana telta ngal a," achi hi.
Amun abawlsaksa a TOUPA bawm hon latou ding in, David in Jerusalem ah Israel tengteng akaikhawmta hi.
Huchi in David in Aaron tapate leh Levi mite akhawm a;
Kohath tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Uriel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmnih;
Merrari tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Asaiah leh a-unaute zanih-le-sawmnih;
Gershom tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Joel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmthum;
Elizaphan tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Shemaiah leh a-unaute zanih;
Hebron tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Eliel leh a-unaute sawmgiat;
Uzziel tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Amminadab leh a-unaute za-le-sawm-le-nih.
David in Zadok leh Abiathar siampute, Levi mite, Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel leh Amminadab asamsak a,
akiang uah, "Noute Levi mite pipute inkuan a lupente na hi ua: kihihsiang unla, nou leh na unaute uh, mun ka bawlsaksa a Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm na laktheihna ding un.
Atung a pan hih ding achih bang a amah i zon louh ziak un, i tung uah TOUPA i Pathian apuakzak hi," achi hi.
Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm latou ding in akisiangsak uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA thu bangbang a Mosi in thu apiak bang in Levi tate'n aliangzang uah huai a chiangtawnte in Pathian bawm azawngta uhi.
David in Levi mi makaipente kiang ah a-unaute uh lasa mite tumging theihte toh, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging leh nuamsa a aw suah ding sep ding in ahilh hi.
Huchi in Levi mite'n Joel tapa Heman asep ua; a-unaute lak ah, Asaph Berekiah tapa; huan Merari tapate a-unaute uh lak ah, Kusaiah tapa Ethan;
amau toh a-unaute uh pawl nihnate, Zekariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, kongkhak ngak mite.
Huchi in lasami, Heman, Asaph, Ethente seh in a-omta ua, ngaihtak a tum ding, dal dakkhutbette toh;
Zekariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, Benaiah, pekging gui sawm neite Alamoth toh kituak a bawl toh;
Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mineiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, Azaziah, kaihgingte Sheminith toh bawl, makai ding in.
Huan Kenaniah, Levi mite lak a amakai lianpen, lapu in apang a: asiam ziak in, la hilh in apang hi.
Berekiah leh Elkanah bawm a dia kongkhak ngak mite in a-om uhi.
Shebaniah, Josaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zekariah, Benaiah, Eliezer, siampute'n, Pathian bawm ma ah pengkulte amut ua: Obed-edom leh Jehiah tuh bawm a dia kongkhak ngakte ahi uhi.
Huan David leh Israel Upa, sangte tung a heutute, Obed-edom inn a kipan TOUPA'N thukhun bawm latou ding in nuamsatak in akuanta uhi.
heading: Jerusalem A Pathian Bawm Laklutna / (2 Sam 6.12-22)

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in TOUPA bawm zawng Levi mite apanpih ziak in, amau bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih in akithoih uhi.
David, puanmalngat hoih puanaktual in akizem a, bawm zawng Levi mi tengteng leh lasa mite leh la heutupa Kenaniah lasa mite toh, huchi in David in puanmalngat siampu lian puanak asilh hi.
Huchibang in Israel tengteng in TOUPA thukhun bawm kikou kawm leh pengkul ging binei toh, pengkulte toh, dakkhutbette toh pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte ngaihtak a ging toh, ahon latouta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thukhun bawm David khopi ahong tun in, Saul tanu Mikal tohlet ah adakkhia a, David lam leh mawl amuta a; alungtang in amusit hi.
